basic_info.description: NEW PRICE! Serene Ocean Views from this outstanding 2BD/2BA Condominium located along San Francisco's most coveted shoreline of Ocean Beach. Updated throughout w/elegant new Flooring, Custom Plantation Shutters & Designer Crown Molding. Expansive open Dining/Liv Rm is streaming w/natural light & perfect for enjoying tranquil Ocean Views. Chef's Galley Kitchen is complete w/brand new LG Stainless Appliances incl; Stove, Refrigerator, Microwave & D/W. Custom White Wood Cabinetry & Granite Counters w/Eat-In Kitchen Island is the perfect place for casual dining. Gracious Primary Suite & Ensuite BA is complimented w/Grand Walk-In Closet plus 2nd spacious Closet, Handsome New Carrara White Stone Vanity & Mirror. Enjoy direct access to a secluded balcony overlooking the manicured central courtyard w/lush greenery. 2nd BD has multiple built-in shelving & allows for various uses as closet doors were removed. Central Hallway accesses the updated Guest BA w/Tiled Shower over Tub & generous Laundry Closet w/Stacked W/D & ample storage. One car-deeded parking & storage locker completes this sensational unit! Bldg Amenities include: Workout Gym, Community Rm, Bike Rm, Carpentry Rm & 2 Outdoor Courtyards w/Seating. Walking Distance to Ocean Beach, GGP,Safeway & Public Transportation. A Must
